name: io.github.thyn-ai/codna
title: Codna — repository intelligence
description: Repo intelligence: triage, fix PRs, SARIF reachability, recall. Free codna login to execute.

packageArguments.description: Run the Codna MCP stdio server (`codna mcp`).

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Provider key for codna_fix's planner — any one of ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (Anthropic), OPENAI_API_KEY (OpenAI/ChatGPT), or GEMINI_API_KEY (Gemini) works (or store one with `codna key set <provider>`). Every tool also requires the one-time free `codna login` device authorization before executing; introspection (initialize/tools/list) needs no credentials.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Write token, only for codna_fix with open_pr=true (opens a pull request) and codna_report_bug (files an issue).

environmentVariables.name: CODNA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Codna key from the one-time free `codna login` (device authorization, free community license). Required to execute any of the five tools; introspection (initialize/tools/list) needs none.
